name: Backend Engineering & Distributed Systems
description: Comprehensive curriculum covering networking, database internals, async architectures, microservices, and distributed consensus.

skills.name: HTTP/1.1 & HTTP/2 Protocols
skills.description: Methods, status codes, headers, chunked transfer, and multiplexing.

skills.name: TCP/IP Sockets & Three-Way Handshake
skills.description: Transport layer fundamentals, socket connections, SYN/ACK, and buffer management.

skills.name: DNS & Name Resolution
skills.description: Recursive vs authoritative resolvers, A/AAAA/CNAME records, and TTL caching.

skills.name: TLS/HTTPS & Certificate Validation
skills.description: Symmetric vs asymmetric keys, certificates, ALPN, and TLS session resumption.

skills.name: RESTful API Architecture
skills.description: Resource-oriented routing, idempotency, HATEOAS, and JSON schema versioning.

skills.name: OS Threads & Process Memory Models
skills.description: Context switching, memory heap vs stack, and concurrency primitives.

skills.name: Non-blocking Async I/O & Event Loops
skills.description: Reactor pattern, epoll/kqueue, promises, and cooperative multitasking.

skills.name: Race Conditions & Mutex Locks
skills.description: Critical sections, deadlocks, semaphores, and lock-free CAS operations.

skills.name: Relational Schema Design & Normalization
skills.description: 1NF through 3NF, foreign key integrity, and denormalization trade-offs.

skills.name: SQL Execution Plans & Query Tuning
skills.description: EXPLAIN ANALYZE, join strategies (nested loop, hash, merge), and indexing.

skills.name: B-Tree & LSM-Tree Indexes
skills.description: Composite indexes, covering indexes, page fill factors, and write amplification.

skills.name: ACID Transactions & Isolation Levels
skills.description: Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable, MVCC, and write skew.

skills.name: Database Connection Pools & Sizing
skills.description: HikariCP/pgbouncer, max connections, keep-alives, and pool starvation.

skills.name: Redis In-Memory Data Structures
skills.description: Strings, Hashes, Sorted Sets, HyperLogLogs, and Redis persistence (RDB/AOF).

skills.name: Caching Patterns & Cache Invalidation
skills.description: Cache-Aside, Write-Through, Write-Behind, TTLs, and stampede prevention.

skills.name: Rate Limiting & Throttling
skills.description: Token bucket, Leaky bucket, Fixed window, and Sliding window counters.

skills.name: JWT Token Authentication & Cryptographic Signing
skills.description: HMAC vs RSA/ECDSA signing, refresh token rotation, and claims validation.

skills.name: OAuth 2.0 & OpenID Connect Flows
skills.description: Authorization code flow with PKCE, client credentials, and ID tokens.

skills.name: Role-Based & Attribute-Based Access Control
skills.description: RBAC vs ABAC, policy enforcement points, and fine-grained authorization.

skills.name: Message Queues & AMQP (RabbitMQ)
skills.description: Exchanges, queues, routing keys, acknowledgements, and dead-letter exchanges.

skills.name: Distributed Event Streaming with Kafka
skills.description: Partitions, consumer groups, offset commits, log compaction, and replication.

skills.name: Idempotent Consumers & Outbox Pattern
skills.description: Transactional outbox, deduplication keys, and exactly-once processing semantics.

skills.name: gRPC & Protocol Buffers
skills.description: Binary serialization, HTTP/2 multiplexing, unary & streaming RPCs.

skills.name: GraphQL APIs & DataLoader N+1 Solvers
skills.description: Queries, mutations, subscriptions, batching with DataLoader, and caching.

skills.name: API Gateways & Reverse Proxies (Nginx/Envoy)
skills.description: SSL termination, upstream load balancing, path rewriting, and CORS management.

skills.name: Docker Containerization & Multi-Stage Builds
skills.description: Dockerfile optimization, layers, cgroups/namespaces, and minimal base images.

skills.name: Multi-Service Orchestration with Docker Compose
skills.description: Service definitions, internal networks, volumes, and health checks.

skills.name: Kubernetes Pods, Services & Deployments
skills.description: Control plane, replica sets, cluster IPs, ingress controllers, and config maps.

skills.name: Automated CI/CD Workflows
skills.description: Automated testing, linting, semantic versioning, container registry publishing.

skills.name: Structured JSON Logging & Correlation IDs
skills.description: Context propagation, trace IDs, log aggregation, and log levels.

skills.name: Application Metrics with Prometheus
skills.description: Counters, Gauges, Histograms, Summaries, and alerting rules.

skills.name: Distributed Tracing with OpenTelemetry
skills.description: Spans, context propagation, Jaeger collectors, and latency analysis.

skills.name: Circuit Breakers & Fault Tolerance
skills.description: Closed/Open/Half-Open states, fallbacks, bulkhead isolation, and timeouts.

skills.name: CAP Theorem & PACELC Trade-Offs
skills.description: Consistency vs Availability vs Partition tolerance in distributed data stores.

skills.name: Database Sharding & Consistent Hashing
skills.description: Range vs hash sharding, virtual nodes, cross-shard queries, and rebalancing.

skills.name: Saga Pattern & Distributed Transactions
skills.description: Choreography vs Orchestration, compensating transactions, and 2PC comparison.

skills.name: Raft Distributed Consensus & Leader Election
skills.description: Leader election, log replication, heartbeats, term counters, and split vote resolution.

skills.name: WebSockets & Real-Time Communication
skills.description: Handshake upgrade, framing, heartbeats, and scaling websocket state with Redis pub/sub.

skills.name: Object Storage & Presigned URLs (S3/MinIO)
skills.description: Direct-to-S3 client uploads, presigned URLs, multipart uploads, and lifecycle policies.

skills.name: Distributed Locking with Redlock
skills.description: Clock drift, lease fencing tokens, and Redis single vs multi-node locks.
